entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh hey, [fName]? I know this is out of[n]the blue, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Like, could we all meet up at Leblanc[n]tomorrow?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, August is almost over already...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That worried tone—could he still have[n]summer vacation homework left to do?
entries.uk: Цей стривожений тон... Невже він досі[n]не зробив домашнього завдання на літо?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Was that Morgana? Whoa, how did he[n]know!?
entries.uk: Це був Моргана? Ого, звідки він[n]знає!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyway! I've already hit up Makoto and[n]the others!
entries.uk: Коротше! Макото й решті я вже[n]написав!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'll be countin' on you to get me through[n]this tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Might as well get some sleep[n]while we can.
